claims.text: Kerala-Born Nithya Raman Unseats Karen Bass to Become Los Angeles Mayor
entities: Kerala-Born Nithya Raman Unseats Karen Bass
claims.llm_reason: Raman unseated Bass to become Los Angeles mayor.

claims.text: The 45-year-old council member will be the city's first Asian American mayor after Bass conceded Thursday, capping a midterm that also sent Amish Shah and Pia Dandiya to Congress.
claims.llm_reason: Raman is the first Asian American mayor; Bass conceded on Thursday.

claims.text: County returns on Wednesday afternoon put Raman ahead 51.67 percent to 48.33 percent, with 405,193 votes against Bass's 379,069
claims.llm_reason: County returns showed Raman at 51.67% and Bass at 48.33%.

claims.text: Born in Kerala in 1981, Raman came to the United States at age six and graduated from Harvard in 2003
claims.llm_reason: Raman was born in 1981, came to the US at six, and graduated Harvard in 2003.

claims.text: In 2020 she unseated Councilmember David Ryu in the 4th District, becoming the first South Asian elected to the City Council
claims.llm_reason: Raman unseated Ryu in 2020, becoming the first South Asian on the council.
